hooks.injection_point: S1 captures additionalContext strings carrying the '\u0000OHM:' prefix into globalThis.__OHM.UserPromptSubmit and neutralizes them downstream (capture XOR passthrough, zero double-mount); S2 mounts the slot as an eight-field 'Hook Memory' section (source orch_hook_memory, cacheHint dynamic) collected into metaUserAttachments by the native KDn filter
hooks.echo_face: journal.mjs per UserPromptSubmit message: locateRoot -> stat brief -> mtime gate against <storage-root>/context/.brief-echo-stamp -> changed and non-empty: stdout {"additionalContext":"\u0000OHM:"+content} (cap 16384); absent/unchanged/empty: stdout stays empty (current behavior preserved). Fail-soft throughout, exit 0
hooks.semantics: sticky slot (grill G2: only a run with a captured string replaces the slot); SessionStart never feeds the slot (grill G3); mount cap 16384 chars with the '…[hook memory truncated]' tail (grill G4); unmarked outputs pass through natively (grill G7). <storage-root> is resolved at runtime from the ZCode user configuration / root.txt pointer - never inlined as a machine path
hooks.interim_note: between the 1.7.1 plugin release and the stage-B install, an unpatched host receives the marked echo as a native additionalContext (one visible NUL-prefixed message per brief change); known transitional shape, disappears at stage B (design-r2 §12)
hooks.bookkeeping: declaration-only: zero new byte mechanism beyond the registered patch_spans; hook registry/lifecycle design out of scope (user simplification ruling 2026-11-11)

install_order: stage B only, on explicit user authorization: (0) gate: sha256(live) == supersedes.patched_sha256_registered (a936cd0e, v1 installed) -> reverse v1 via actions-v1-superseded.json on a temp copy, verify sha256 == base.sha256; (1) apply actions.json (v2) to the temp copy -> node --check -> count gates; (2) install; (3) backfill patched_sha256_registered with the live-measured sha and re-pin the spans. A live bundle not matching either registered sha = stale anchors = re-pin flow.

rollback.procedure: reverse one-shot for the two replace spans (q17-S2 then q17-S1, reverse apply order): locate the payload (unique) and swap back to the anchor literal; byte-exact restore verified by sha256 == base.sha256. To return further to the v1 state, replay actions-v1-superseded.json on the restored base (ledger closes at a936cd0e).
post_rollback_verify: canary gone: meta_user returns to the native shape (no 'Hook Memory' section)
rollback.host_upgrade_repatch: sha256(live) != base.sha256 and != the v1 registered sha -> anchors stale -> re-pin flow: re-measure anchors on the new bundle, re-register spans, re-run the Q17-01 dry-run expect_count=1, then wait for the explicit user authorization again

verify_before_install: live identity gate: sha256(live bundle) == supersedes.patched_sha256_registered (a936cd0e) -> reverse v1 first; a live bundle still carrying v1 payloads fails the q17-S2 anchor gate by design (install-order discipline)
Q17-01 dry-run: every anchor literal count == 1 on the restored base
apply to a temp copy + node --check + post-checks (never patch in place)
authorization gate: the user explicitly issues commands/orch-meta-user-patch.md AND the patcher QA has passed (double gate)
live_probes_not_in_run_all: canary: a fresh interactive session's meta_user contains a 'Hook Memory' section whose content starts with the brief first line ('orch-meta-user: v1' marker)
mtime reread: rewrite the brief mid-session -> the next message echoes (one-message shape) and the next request carries the new content
unmarked third-party UserPromptSubmit additionalContext passes through natively (capture-XOR probe, grill G7)
plugin unload -> no marked output -> the mounted section disappears from new requests (fail-soft probe)
compression survival: the Hook Memory section survives context compression (structural; slot on globalThis, mount re-read per request)
